INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLUSR_SELECT_SRC
(
				 [ACCESS_FLAG]
				,[ALLOW_PSWD_EXP]
				,[BDAY]
				,[BRANCH_ID]
				,[CD]
				,[CHANGE_CNT]
				,[CHNG_PSWD_FLAG]

				,[EXP_DT]

				,[LAST_NM]
				,[LAST_PSWD_UPD_DT]

				,[MOBILE_NO]
				,[OLD_STATUS]

				,[PSWD_ALT]
				,[RETRY_CNT]
				,[SESSION_ID]
				,[STATUS]
				,[SUSPEND_DT_FROM]
				,[SUSPEND_DT_TO]
				,[UPDATED_BY]
				,[UPDATED_DT]
				,[VERSION]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
				 CC.[ACCESS_FLAG]
				,CC.[ALLOW_PSWD_EXP]
				,CC.[BDAY]
				,CC.[BRANCH_ID]
				,CC.[CD]
				,CC.[CHANGE_CNT]
				,CC.[CHNG_PSWD_FLAG]
				,CC.[COUNTRY_NO]
				,CC.[CREATED_BY]
				,CC.[CREATED_DT]
				,CC.[CUMM_CNT]
				,CC.[DEL]
				,CC.[DEPT_ID]
				,CC.[EFFECTIVITY_DT]
				,CC.[EMAIL]
				,CC.[EXP_DT]
				,CC.[FIRST_NM]
				,CC.[GRP_ID]
				,CC.[ID]
				,CC.[IMAGE]
				,CC.[INV_LOGIN_CNT]
				,CC.[IS_ALL_CORPORATION]
				,CC.[IS_LOGIN]
				,CC.[LAST_LOGIN_DT]
				,CC.[LAST_NM]
				,CC.[LAST_PSWD_UPD_DT]
				,CC.[LOCAL_TRUNK_NO]
				,CC.[MID_NM]
				,CC.[MOBILE_NO]
				,CC.[OLD_STATUS]
				,CC.[OVRD_LIMIT]
				,CC.[PSWD]
				,CC.[PSWD_ALT]
				,CC.[RETRY_CNT]
				,CC.[SESSION_ID]
				,CC.[STATUS]
				,CC.[SUSPEND_DT_FROM]
				,CC.[SUSPEND_DT_TO]
				,CC.[UPDATED_BY]
				,CC.[UPDATED_DT]
				,CC.[VERSION]
				,CC.[FILE_NAME]
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.BOB_TBLUSR CC
			JOIN d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLUSR B 
			ON CC.ID = B.ID
			AND CC.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';

				,[BDAY]

				,[CD]

				,[CUMM_CNT]

				,[EFFECTIVITY_DT]
				,[EMAIL]
				,[EXP_DT]
				,[FIRST_NM]
				,[GRP_ID]
				,[ID]
				,[IMAGE]
				,[INV_LOGIN_CNT]
				,[IS_ALL_CORPORATION]
				,[IS_LOGIN]
				,[LAST_LOGIN_DT]
				,[LAST_NM]
				,[LAST_PSWD_UPD_DT]
				,[LOCAL_TRUNK_NO]

				,[PSWD_ALT]

				,[SESSION_ID]
				,[STATUS]
				,[SUSPEND_DT_FROM]
				,[SUSPEND_DT_TO]
				,[UPDATED_BY]
				,[UPDATED_DT]
				,[VERSION]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_BOB_TBLUSR]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.BOB_TBLUSR A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLUSR_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
